correctness.rationale: The specified relabeling of Herschel has 11 vertices, 18 edges, degree multiset (3^8,4^3); independent graph reconstruction checked 3-vertex connectivity and every vertex having a degree-3 neighbor. Enumerating all C(11,3) triples gives 123 disconnected triples, precisely 123 pure 7-dimensional cut facets and 1,930 augmented faces. Independent exhaustive Morse matching produces 957 face/coface pairs and critical cells 0:1,6:1,7:13, with complete 1,929-node, 10,238-incidence Hasse DAG. Exact integral signed chain reduction computes the entire 1x13 Morse boundary to be zero. The 6-skeleton is S6; all 7-cells attach with zero degrees in π6(S6)≅Z, implying S6∨(∨13S7). Nonzero H6 excludes purity-level shellability; published Bayer et al Cor.5.5 exactly applies to the 3-connected, degree-three-neighbor Herschel to prove induced-subgraph-minimal nonshellability. The minimal-forbidden criterion is prior work, not independently novel.
